fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 4 damage, with a 40% chance to be left [Hindered] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tidal Nudge
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 12 damage, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drifting Calm
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 4s after using it.

fusions.name: Easy Breath
fusions.desc: Each time you gain health, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 10 seconds.
